gaps.detail: Closed 2026-10-09: all values read on a Full seat (tokens.json).
gaps.proposal: Designer sends a link to the palette specimen node -> one get_variable_defs; or one Full-seat use_figma run reading all collections per mode; then 'update the catalog'

gaps.detail: Modes confirmed (2.theme light/dark; 1.brand bank/kassa/travel/artwin/koko). Remaining: duplicate brand/<product>/* variables in 2.theme.
gaps.proposal: Confirm mode names; product branding only via 1.brand modes; keep brand/<product>/* only for cross-product UI (logos, product switcher) or remove

gaps.detail: Mobile = Nunito confirmed; web/CRM = Inter Mbank, not an org shared font, so web/CRM instances cannot be placed via MCP.
gaps.proposal: Confirm the per-platform font; one variable font/family/primary with Web/Mobile modes; hand over Inter Mbank woff2 + licence

gaps.detail: Dark values exist for all 256 vars, but some look wrong: artwin/travel ghost dark = #2563EB33, neutral/positive dark = light values, static/on-accent and *on-accent-muted dark-on-dark.
gaps.proposal: Fill Dark for every 2.theme variable; theme by mode, drop per-component dark variants (keep only 'inverted' where it is a design intent)

gaps.detail: Type scale spread over Web components (font/Heading, font/Body), Mobile KIT (body/*, label/*), Starter KIT and DS:Mbank; none in Foundation; h1-h6 and body m/xl metrics unknown
gaps.proposal: Move text styles to Foundation as one scale (display/heading/body/label/caption x regular/medium/bold) with platform family via variable

gaps.detail: Shadows defined in Web components (each published twice) and Mobile KIT with different names (shadow/Default, shadow/tooltip)
gaps.proposal: One shadow scale in Foundation (shadow/xs..xl, modal, tooltip); unpublish duplicates

gaps.detail: No spacing in Foundation; parallel schemes spacing/*, rem/default/*, paddings/default/* (+ Starter KIT 3.Spacing); names not monotonic (s-1=12, s-3=8)
gaps.proposal: Foundation collection 'spacing' on a 4px scale (space/0..24), alias the others, then deprecate them

gaps.detail: 1.brand radius/* and 4.border-radius border-radius/* duplicate each other; CRM topHeader resolves radius/xs=8 while Web/Mobile resolve 4
gaps.proposal: Keep one radius collection, alias the other to it, fix the conflicting binding in CRM topHeader

gaps.detail: Reported during inventory as a duplicate of text/muted (not present in the inventory files; verify)
gaps.proposal: Merge into text/muted or rename the group so text and icons share one token

gaps.detail: No focus state anywhere (Button, FloatButton, Chips, Tabs, Segment, Switchers, Inputs); Mobile button lacks pressed/focus; Chips/Tabs/Segments lack disabled; Cell lacks pressed/disabled; mobile inputDropdown lacks active/typing; checkbox lacks error/indeterminate
